annotations.title: Agent State Graph Differ, Belief Conflict Resolver & SHA-256 Hasher

description: Computes structural diffs between two agent state snapshots ('added_keys', 'mutated_keys', 'removed_keys'), flags boolean belief contradictions, generates an RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch delta, and computes a canonical checkpoint hash. Use when checkpointing agent state or transmitting minimal RFC 7396 state deltas across multi-agent handoffs; for counting BPE tokens and auditing Lost-in-the-Middle prompt attention, use plan_context_token_budget instead. Read-only call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'previous_state_json' (with enum defaults), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

conflict_strategy.description: Resolution policy when keys conflict; defaults to 'prefer_current' when omitted.

current_state_json.description: JSON string or object representing the updated agent state snapshot.

previous_state_json.description: JSON string or object representing the prior agent state snapshot.

name: diff_agent_memory_checkpoint

added_keys.description: State keys newly introduced in current_state.

checkpoint_digest.description: Deterministic cryptographic hash of the canonicalized merged state.

mutated_keys.description: Modified keys with before/after values and belief_contradiction flag.

rfc7396_json_merge_patch_delta.description: Minimal RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch payload transforming previous into current.
